name: White Bean-Cranberry Roll Ups with Roasted Parsnips & Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 medium parsnips
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and cut carrots and parsnips lengthwise into quarters, then crosswise into 2-inch long pieces; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Drizzle the veggies with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander. Place in a medium bowl and mash with a potato masher or fork until semi-smooth.
Add mayo, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the beans; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the cranberries, and stir to combine the bean filling.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, spread evenly with the bean filling, and top with mixed greens; roll tightly to close, then cut in half.
To serve, divide roll ups and roasted veggies between plates. Enjoy!
